summary: Iteration 2 full-stack verification for learntolarp.com. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass covering root provider info, live autocomplete, alias/variant resolution (The Beatles ↔ Beatles ↔ beatles ↔ beatle all resolve to same slug with incrementing infiltration_count), approved-list gate with <500ms queued response for random strings (verified 2s cap in test), vote incrementing, alias-slug GET fallback, admin token gating (401 without, 200 with), explicit queue endpoint, public queue list, entities list. Frontend: landing loads with theme toggle (persists 'dark' to localStorage), Live autocomplete dropdown shows 'THE BEATLES · COMPILED · A' when typing 'beat', queued flow navigates to /entity/<slug> and renders the QueuedState card with vote count and 'We don't burn API on random queries' note, /entity/the-beatles renders full case file with all data-testid sections (entity-hero, briefing-tldr-card, fact-section, culture-section, quotes-section, perception-section, starters-section, cross-ref-grid), Export cheat sheet modal opens with portrait share card (Download PNG + Copy Text). No Google sign-in button, no /binder route, no 'LIVE COMPILE' indicator in header — all removals confirmed.

issues: Two 404 resource errors in console on landing — likely a missing favicon or asset. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: (Low priority) Investigate two 404s logged in browser console on landing (likely favicon/manifest asset).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is under 700 lines and cleanly structured — OK.
variant_keys handles plural/singular only via simple s-suffix rule; edge cases like 'wolves'→'wolf' won't alias, but acceptable for scope.
admin_approve uses `_id: 0` projection consistently — good, avoids ObjectId leak.
compile_case_file has no timeout guard beyond httpx (90s for OpenRouter); if Anthropic path stalls, request could hang. Consider a wrapper timeout.
seed_approved_once only seeds when approved collection is empty — modifying APPROVED_SEED later requires manual DB clear or admin/approve calls. Acceptable but document.
seed_data_creation: None manually created; ~40 approved seed entities auto-seeded on backend startup via seed_approved_once(). Test only exercised The Beatles + Nirvana approved paths and dynamic unique-suffix queued items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend 13-test pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is stable and re-usable. Alias resolution, approved gate, admin auth, and queued-fast-path all verified. Frontend visually confirmed for theme toggle, autocomplete, queued state, entity page, export modal. No Google auth remnants remain (no imports break, no /binder route in App.js).
